symptom: An error handler's row was centred 90px under its activity (retrieve at 360;200, handler activity at 360;290): a 30px gap, inside the output variable and type Studio Pro prints under the box. A handler in a THEN branch also overlapped the ELSE row (+90 against +100). mx check: 0 errors.
cause: addErrorHandlerFlow (and the web-service call and the pending-handler terminal end event) used VerticalSpacing, a constant shared with type-split branches and RowGap; measureStatement gave an activity with a handler body the height of a bare activity, so the IF placed its ELSE row as if the handler row did not exist
insight: The issue's ~140px was an estimate; Studio Pro's own documents settle it: 160 distinct handler rows straight under their activity (ako/TestApp, PedApp, seven .mpk apps) have a median offset of 130px, quartiles 125..150, minimum 90. IF branch rows measured the same way sit a median 134px under the split, but mxcli's +100 else row already leaves 40px, clear of the ~35px label, so only the handler pitch changed; give it its own constant rather than raising VerticalSpacing, which also drives RowGap and type-split branches. Write the measured number into the test literally: a test comparing against the builder's own constant passed at 90 and proved nothing.
